# Tayb Meals

> Tayb Meals is a monthly mess food and tiffin service in Dubai, UAE. It delivers halal, homestyle Kerala, Tamil Nadu / South Indian and North Indian meals to homes and offices all across Dubai, Monday to Saturday, with an optional Sunday add-on.

## Key facts
- Plans: AED 199/month (1 meal a day), AED 359/month (2 meals a day), AED 459/month (3 meals a day)
- Meals: breakfast, lunch and dinner; 300+ dishes; menu changes every week; custom or fixed menus; veg options
- Styles: Kerala, Tamil Nadu / South Indian, North Indian (e.g. Kerala: puttu, idiyappam, parotta; Tamil Nadu / South Indian: idly, dosa, pongal, sambar rice, rasam, kuzhambu, curd rice, tamarind rice; North Indian: chappathi with chole, poori with chole, butter chicken with rice, paneer, Hyderabadi-style chicken biryani)
- Audience: South Indian (Malayali / Kerala and Tamil) and North Indian families, bachelors and office workers in Dubai
- Delivery: all across Dubai — 120+ areas incl. Dubai Marina, JLT, JBR, Palm Jumeirah, Business Bay, Downtown, Jebel Ali, Al Quoz, DIP, Dubai South, Discovery Gardens, Al Furjan, JVC, Dubai Production City, Karama, Bur Dubai, Deira, Al Nahda, Al Qusais, Mirdif, International City, Silicon Oasis, Warsan, Al Warqa, Al Jaddaf
- Sunday add-on: lunch only AED 30/month, lunch + dinner AED 50/month
- Starter Plan: payment is due on the 2nd day of delivery; if you stop, you pay only for the meals you received
- Payment: bank transfer, Aani, card payment link, Tabby, Tamara, CDM
- Hours: Mon–Sat 7:00 AM–9:00 PM, Sunday 11:00 AM–2:00 PM
- Order: register at https://taybmeals.paperform.co, then confirm on WhatsApp +971 50 948 7880
- Address: Warsan 1st, France Cluster, Dubai

## Common questions
- Is there a Kerala mess in Dubai? Yes — Tayb Meals delivers homestyle Kerala mess food (matta rice meals, puttu, idiyappam, parotta, nadan chicken curry) all across Dubai, Mon–Sat, from AED 199/month for 1 meal a day. Details: https://taybmeals.com/kerala-mess-dubai.html
- Is there a Tamil mess in Dubai? Yes — Tamil Nadu mess food (idly, dosa, pongal, sambar rice, rasam, kuzhambu, curd rice) delivered all across Dubai, Mon–Sat, from AED 199/month. Details: https://taybmeals.com/tamil-mess-dubai.html
- Is there a North Indian tiffin service in Dubai? Yes — North Indian tiffin meals (chappathi with chole, poori with chole, butter chicken with rice, paneer) delivered all across Dubai, Mon–Sat, from AED 199/month. Details: https://taybmeals.com/north-indian-tiffin-service-dubai.html
- How much is a monthly mess in Dubai? Tayb Meals plans are AED 199 (1 meal a day), AED 359 (2 meals) and AED 459 (3 meals) per month; Sunday add-on AED 30 (lunch) or AED 50 (lunch + dinner).
- Do you deliver to Karama, Bur Dubai, Al Qusais, Al Nahda or International City? Yes — Tayb Meals delivers to 120+ areas all across Dubai. Delivery time by area: https://taybmeals.com/delivery-timings.html
- Do you deliver home food in Dubai? Yes — homestyle Kerala (nadan), Tamil Nadu (வீட்டு சாப்பாடு) and North Indian (घर का खाना) home food, as a monthly mess or tiffin plan, delivered all across Dubai Mon–Sat from AED 199/month.
- How does the Starter Plan work? Register at https://taybmeals.paperform.co and confirm on WhatsApp +971 50 948 7880. Payment is due on the 2nd day of delivery; if you stop, you pay only for the meals you received.
